Resolves #20014

The maximized-strip suppression case in `DockTabSortZone.spec.mjs` now binds `resolveDraggedItemId` like its sibling stubs, so it runs again on `dev`. Since #20005, `TabSortZone#onDragMove` resolves the dragged item through that method. This case, added by #20000 on a base without it, threw `TypeError: me.resolveDraggedItemId is not a function`, which turned every PR's `unit` check red.

Evidence: L2 (the unit runner drives the case: red on plain `dev`, green with the binding) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2).

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one stub key in one spec, no source change.

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `DockTabSortZone.spec.mjs`, the maximized-strip suppression case. It threw on plain `dev` 4350ad7804 and passes with the binding. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the `unit` check runs the full suite. |
